title: Best practice
content: I have been with this surgery for a few years now and am very happy with the care I have received. The clinicians are friendly, knowledgable and help you to make informed decisions. I’ve never had an issue booking appointments or getting prescriptions sorted. Receptionists are always polite, respectful and helpful. I’m really grateful, thank you for all you do.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
